g.text: Model mysteries: debug MONA
MONA
Asha, every case starts with something strange MONA does. Don't guess yet: run the experiments (1, 2, 3) on the real model, look
at the evidence, then name the cause (A, B or C).
🔁 MONA repeats herself forever ✅
❓ Ask a question, get more questions
🔁 MONA repeats herself forever
🎭 Confident, fluent, and wrong
📜 Great at Hindi, weak at Awadhi
🩺 Symptom
🧩 Why does “unbelievably” cost 5
A user set MONA to 'always pick the most likely word' to make her more
tokens but “the” only 1?
accurate. Now she writes the same phrase again and again.
🧪 Experiments (press 1, 2, 3)
1. Generate with temperature 0 vs 0.8 ✓
2. Look at the probabilities inside the loop ✓
3. Same prompt, three runs each
🔍 What's the cause? (press A, B or C)
A. The model is broken and needs retraining
B. Always taking the top word (greedy decoding) lets a phrase feed itself
C. The text is longer than MONA's context window
📋 Evidence
[1] Generate with temperature 0 vs 0.8
temperature 0.0:
“The history of India’s history is a fascinating one. It is
a fascinating and important book, and it is a must-have guide for anyone who
wishes to learn more about India’s history. It is a must-have guide for
anyone who wishes to learn more about India’s history, its history,”
